subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should OpenClaw accept optional top-level `res.meta` as an additive v4 response-envelope field for this bug fix once the branch is rebased?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and proven, but the protocol envelope is a public compatibility surface and older strict validators may reject an added top-level field.

options.title: Accept additive `res.meta`
options.body: Land the PR after conflict resolution and green checks, treating optional response metadata as an allowed additive v4 field documented for clients to tolerate or ignore.

options.title: Version-gate or redesign metadata
options.body: Pause this PR and require a v5/version-gated or payload-level metadata contract if maintainers do not want top-level response fields added under v4.

recommendation.title: Accept additive `res.meta`
recommendation.body: Land the PR after conflict resolution and green checks, treating optional response metadata as an allowed additive v4 field documented for clients to tolerate or ignore.
